shots.text: At Umbrael we fought the Hollow King, Nyxara's madness wearing an iron crown. When it broke, Nyxara stepped out of it with the crown in her hand.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Hollow King breaking into two shades; one dissolves, the other becomes Nyxara, tall, a starfield for a face, holding a broken iron crown.

shots.text:
I fought it the whole time.

And your Grey Lantern is alive. I hear him walking under my land, toward you.
shots.speaker: nyxara
shots.art_note: Nyxara looking down into the Rift, the stars in her face moving.

shots.text: All six Wardens were free, and every land was ours again.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The six Wardens' lights, one in each land, seen on the painted map of the Ring.
